summary: Approved. Static review confirms regular inspection images now use top-level images/* paths, DepthImage is not logged under spear/camera, RGB projection and images/rgb share a 3-channel RGB conversion that drops alpha, and the docs describe the corrected hierarchy. The rotating 2D image hierarchy issue should be resolved by moving regular inspection images out from under spear/* into top-level images/* paths.
work_completed: Reviewed examples/flashlight/run_programmatic_rerun.py for Rerun entity paths, RGB conversion, and DepthImage logging.
Reviewed examples/flashlight/README.md and docs/running_our_example_applications.md for corrected Rerun path documentation.
Ran a non-simulator syntax check with python -m py_compile examples/flashlight/run_programmatic_rerun.py.
Ran static text checks for spear/images, images/*, spear/camera, DepthImage, rgb_projection, rr.Image, and RGB conversion references.

findings.message: examples/flashlight/run_programmatic_rerun.py:63-68 defines regular inspection image paths as top-level images/rgb, images/depth_meters, images/depth_meters_visualization, images/world_normal_visualization, and images/diffuse_color_visualization; static search found no spear/images references in the reviewed files.

examples/flashlight/run_programmatic_rerun.py:328 is the only rr.DepthImage log found, and it logs to RERUN_IMAGE_PATHS["depth_meters"] == images/depth_meters, not under spear/camera. The camera hierarchy contains pose/frustum and spear/camera/rgb_projection only.

examples/flashlight/run_programmatic_rerun.py:203-211 converts final-tone-curve data by selecting channels [2, 1, 0], which drops alpha when present and yields 3-channel RGB. The same rgb_image is logged with color_model="RGB" to both spear/camera/rgb_projection and images/rgb at lines 325-327.

examples/flashlight/README.md:68-80 and docs/running_our_example_applications.md:79-88 document regular 2D streams under images/*, RGB projection under spear/camera/rgb_projection, and depth outside spear/camera; they do not claim regular 2D images are under spear.
Live SPEAR/Rerun validation was not run because the task explicitly prohibited simulator-dependent commands; review is based on static inspection plus py_compile.

follow_up_recommendations: Run the live Rerun stream with a simulator and viewer when available to visually confirm the corrected entity hierarchy and non-black RGB projection.
